title: Manager at Independent Distributor Expects Marvell Demand to Remain Strong Amid AI and Networking Growth
expert: Manager at an independent (open-market) electronic-component distributor; own Marvell purchases and sales
verdict: An independent distributor's own Marvell business reached almost 300,000 last quarter vs a typical 50,000-100,000, with fill rates only about 50% and quoted lead times doubled to 12-24 weeks.

Custom program roster and scope: almost 300,000 Marvell business last quarter vs 50,000-100,000 typical, first-hand (small open-market view); consistent with BlueFin MRVL TSMC production +36% y/y (SB #62115). → Tenet 1 (custom) ↑
AI/ML and compute added a 50%-60% increment to demand last quarter, first-hand; Marvell seen gaining at the custom-compute level.
Interconnect growth rate: networking/telecom 30%-40% of the mix (estimate); requirements moving 800 Gb → 1.6 Tb → 3.2 Tb. → Tenet 2 (interconnect) →
Supply & lead times: lead times doubled to 12-24 weeks, first-hand; consistent with management's acutely constrained supply (SB #59559).
fill rate about 50%, somewhat higher than 90 days ago, first-hand; first read on fill rate.

changes: Distributor Marvell business almost 300,000 last quarter vs 50,000-100,000 typical (first-hand) vs BlueFin MRVL TSMC production Sept-Q +36% y/y, Dec-Q >40% y/y (SB #62115): consistent.
Lead times doubled to 12-24 weeks (first-hand) vs management saying supply remains acutely constrained (SB #59559): consistent (tightening).
Expected 2026 growth 20%-25% for the distributor's Marvell business (estimate) vs company FY27 revenue +45% (SB #65482): conflicting (channel grows slower).
First read on open-market fill rate (about 50%, up from 90 days ago); no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (custom multi-customer): ↑ — AI/ML and compute added a 50%-60% increment; Marvell gaining at the custom-compute level.
Tenet 2 (interconnect >70%): → — networking/telecom 30%-40% of the mix; no growth figure for interconnect.
Tenet 5 (bear flank): → — Broadcom demand similar and its allocation smoother; no share figure.
